docs.description: The tree: [{id, label, icon?, children?: [...], lazy?: true}]. A lazy item without children asks for them with sb-load when opened.
Loaded children by parent id: {"<id>": [items]}. Bind it to a signal the server patches (see the docs).
How many items can be selected.
Selection: an id, or ids separated by spaces (multiple). A new value from the server replaces it; the live value is the value property.
Open items: ids separated by spaces. A new list from the server replaces it; lazy items in it load their children.
Server-confirmed value: :state(pending) while the local value differs from the server's value attribute (see revert()).
Name reported in sb-change (e.g. the field of a command).

events.name: sb-load
events.description: A lazy item was opened and has no children yet. detail: { id }. Answer by adding its children to the loaded prop.

events.name: sb-change
events.description: The selection changed. detail: { name, value } (an id, or an array of ids for multiple): ready for a command.

events.name: sb-toggle
events.description: An item opened or closed. detail: { id, open }.
